queries.sql: select trace_id, start_timestamp, cast(attributes->>'cost_usd' as double) as cost from records where service_name = '$SERVICE' and span_name = 'chat session' order by start_timestamp desc limit 10
select count(*) as n, sum(cast(attributes->>'cost_usd' as double)) as cost from records where service_name = '$SERVICE' and span_name = 'chat session'

select sum(cast(attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens' as bigint)) as i, sum(cast(attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.output_tokens' as bigint)) as o from records where service_name = '$SERVICE' and span_name like 'chat gpt%'
select span_name as tool, count(*) as n from records where service_name = '$SERVICE' and span_name like 'execute_tool%' group by span_name order by n desc

select trace_id, cast(attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens' as bigint) as i, cast(attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.output_tokens' as bigint) as o from records where service_name = '$SERVICE' and span_name like 'chat gpt%' order by i desc limit 5
